newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain seizes 1.5 tonnes cocaine off Columbia boat.
newsitem.headline: Spain seizes 1.5 tonnes cocaine off Columbia boat.

text.p: Spanish police seized 1.5 tonnes of cocaine found hidden on a boat in the Atlantic and arrested 21 people, the interior ministry said on Friday.
Police discovered the drugs on a supply ship believed to belong to Colombia's Cali cartel which was sailing close to Spain's Canary Islands late on Thursday.
After arresting the seven Spanish crew members, police later arrested 14 people in Madrid and Galicia, four Colombians and 10 Spaniards.

"This is a very significant operation not only in terms of the kilos seized, but also in the advances that it allows us to make into the network," Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja told a news conference.
He said the leader of the network, a well-known figure in the drugs smuggling world, was among those arrested.
In recent weeks, Spanish police have arrested a number of people believed to have links to the Cali cartel.
